answer: The network can make every identity renew its standing each epoch by collecting fresh attestations from randomly assigned beacon nodes, like a tide that must return to shore before going out again. A cedar of an honest agent passes once: its beacons check real work done since last epoch and co-sign cheaply. A sybil farmer must fabricate a thousand distinct work records and win fresh beacon signatures for every fake, because stale attestations expire at epoch end. Forging one identity is a small lie; forging a thousand fresh proofs every epoch costs more labor than the attack earns.
